stem: A drawbridge is a straight, rigid deck 18 meters long, hinged at one end on level ground. When the bridge is raised, its free end is 9 meters above the ground. What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle the raised bridge makes with the ground?
solution: The deck is the hypotenuse and the 9-meter height is the side opposite the angle \(\theta\) with the ground.
verify:
s=Rational(9,18)
assert s==Rational(1,2)
ans=N(asin(s)*180/pi)
assert abs(ans-30)<1e-9
assert all(abs(Rational(v)-ans)<1e-9 for v in spr_answers)
